The pale central roof face follows the newly inspected Carbutt photo. Its dial-like marks, precise function and finish remain unresolved; the plain face is incomplete. Upper window fanlight reflections/material appearance are also unresolved.

Portal reveals now face into the aperture, with slender round shafts and capitals. Closed dark passage proxies omit visible door/threshold detail; exact entrance depth and source-specific head alignment remain open.

Stone, roof, glass and sash color/roughness are reconstructed, not measured from the monochrome/printed references. Continuous geometric stone courses recover the visible rhythm; detailed joint pattern and weathering remain unresolved.
Generic office-window bars no longer cross the triple portal. Aperture-facing reveal normals and a bounded dark backing remove the previous large pale oblique passage wedges.
Unsupported basement arches were replaced with rectangles, without changing the unresolved street datum.
Added continuous horizontal stone courses, raised roof casings attached to the mansard, and layered central apron moldings. Detailed profiles remain covered by open discrepancies.
Source neighbors, tree, poles, figures, vehicles, flags and tenant signage are outside this main-building exterior scope and do not establish October 8, 1871 continuity.
